page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Above the text: the running head "DE SACRA" and the page number at the head. Below the last line: the catchword "homi-" at the right.

main_text.p: Quid ni dicamus, Deum illis missurum, qui explicent, si non alios, saltem Spiritum sanctum?
14. Ephef.6. Patres nolite ad iracundiam provocare liberos vestros, sed instruite illos in timore Domini, &c. Quomodo verò hoc fecerint Patres, sine lectione scripturarum?

15. Ad Romanos, & alibi salutat priuatas familias, & eas vocat Ecclesias. Quamobrem ita vocat? Quia in ædibus priuatim precabantur, quæ etiam in Ecclesia publicè. Preces enim fiebant simul à tota familia, & scripturæ legebantur & explicabantur.

16. 1.Thess.5.[?] Ad vniuersos singulosque fideles scribens, ait: Adhortemini vos mutuo, & edificetis singuli singulos. Volebat igitur Apostolus, vt singuli essent sibi mutuò doctores & pastores. Quomodo autem hoc potuis-sent præstare officium, sine assidua scriptu-rarum lectione & cognitione.
17. 1. Timoth. 2. Deus vult omnes homines saluos fieri, & ad cognitionem veritatis venire. Ergo cuiusque hominis est, dare operam legendis S. Bibliis, vt per hæc ad cognitionem veritatis perueniant.

2.Timoth.2. Quæ audiuisti à me inter multos testes, hæc propone fidelibus hominibus, qui eruntidonei ad alios quoq; docendos. Vult igitur Apostolus, non solùm sacerdotes, sed etiam Laicos ita proficere in scripturis, vt etiam aliosipsi possint docere.
Atque vt speciatim ad multos Laicorum

page.notes: The page number is printed at the head; the last digit is small and read as 4 with a doubt, so it is marked [?]. The "5" after "Thess." in the reference of paragraph 16 is hard to read and is marked [?]. The printed text has no visible word space in "eruntidonei" and "aliosipsi"; these are copied as they appear. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The catchword "homi-" is the start of the next page. Faint show-through along the right edge is not transcribed.
